gloss: letter to the editor, written contribution

definitions.gloss: letter to the editor, written contribution
definitions.explanation: A letter or message sent to a newspaper, magazine, or organization expressing opinions or providing information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{投書|とうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent a letter to the newspaper.

examples.japanese: {投書|とうしょ}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}った→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: My opinion was published in the letters column.

examples.japanese: ⟦{匿名|とくめい}→匿名：11797_tokumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{投書|とうしょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{投書|とうしょ} refers to letters or contributions sent to publications.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {投書|とうしょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to send a letter (to an editor)
- {投書|とうしょ}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: letters column, reader's section
- ⟦{匿名|とくめい}→匿名：11797_tokumei⟧{投書|とうしょ}: anonymous letter
- {投書|とうしょ}⟦{箱|ばこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧: suggestion box

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧: contribution, submission
- ⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: reader's voice
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: opinion
